name: Chicken Malai Boti
description: Creamy Pakistani chicken malai boti marinated with yogurt, cream, green chilies and mild spices, then grilled until tender and smoky.
ingredients: 750 g boneless chicken, cut into cubes
method: Pat the chicken dry and place it in a bowl.
Mix yogurt, cream, ginger-garlic paste, lemon juice, green chilies, cumin, pepper, garam masala, cornflour and salt.
Coat the chicken well and marinate for at least 1 hour in the refrigerator.
Thread the chicken onto skewers and brush lightly with oil.
Grill, barbecue or cook in a hot grill pan, turning regularly, until lightly charred and fully cooked.
Rest for a few minutes before serving with chutney, onion and lemon.
